name: classicube
description: Build and explore a blocky 3D world.
author: UnknownShadow200 (ClassiCube), ported to SwirlOS
title: ClassiCube
tagline: A Minecraft Classic-style sandbox, ported to SwirlOS.
long: ClassiCube is an open-source voxel sandbox in the spirit of Minecraft Classic. Place and break blocks, explore a generated world and build whatever you like. Runs on SwirlOS with the built-in software renderer, singleplayer only for now, no sound yet.\nWASD to move, mouse to look, Space to jump, B for the block menu, Esc for the menu. Worlds are saved in your ClassiCube folder.\nNote: uses the same memory region as DOOM, so don't run both at once. Needs SwirlOS r105 or newer for mouse look.
